summary: PRD-02 Work Responsibility & Tracking fully validated backend + frontend. Ran 15 pytest backend tests (all pass) covering scoping, gating, reconciliation counts, idempotency, gap detection, permission enforcement, aging/SLA change, no-direct-completion, and the sensitive_approval OPEN→COMPLETED lifecycle with Super Admin distinction. Playwright frontend run confirms: Admin Support sees exactly [support_ticket, kyc_review, legacy_claim] cards with NO Team Monitor/Konfigurasi buttons; Super Admin (my) shows sensitive_approval only, Team Monitor toggle reveals all 8 work types, Konfigurasi dialog exposes SLA inputs + role chips, Riwayat tab renders completed sensitive_approval row with Super Admin badge. Cleanup performed (label rate restored via direct rate-change; test rate-change docs and their work_items deleted).

issues: Radix DialogContent missing Description/aria-describedby (a11y warning in console); low priority

action_items: (Optional) Add DialogDescription or aria-describedby to work-config-dialog to silence Radix a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: work_service.py reconcile is nicely idempotent via dedupe_key + status:open filter and 8s throttle — good.
_resolve_completion for legacy_claim relies on label.claim_resolved_by; ensure that field is set by the actual claim resolution endpoint (out of scope here).
Overdue rule (date.today() > opened_date + sla_days) matches spec: overdue only AFTER SLA day passes.
No endpoint accepts a client-supplied completed status; completion is projection-only — matches security requirement.
test_credentials: Used credentials from review_request (superadmin/finance1/support1). All logged in successfully.
seed_data_creation: None persistent. Test created 1 label_rate_change_request (Demo Label PPR 60%→55%) and approved it to exercise OPEN→COMPLETED, then restored rate to 60% and deleted the request doc + associated work_items row.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend Work layer routes are at /api/admin/work/{queue,history,responsibilities,settings/sla}. WorkQueue.jsx at /admin/work. Reconciliation is throttled ~8s — when testing completion history, sleep 9s after triggering the state change then re-hit /admin/work/queue (queue fetch triggers reconcile) before checking /admin/work/history. Super Admin's My Work only shows sensitive_approval by default (super_admin is only responsible for that type).
